Subject: Preferential onboarding credit request — Brightwave Labs (28% ask)

Team —

Quick ask: Brightwave Labs (healthcare analytics, Series B) is asking for a preferential onboarding credit/discount on Hosted API usage — requesting 28% off list for the first 12 months as part of a multi-region rollout and marketplace co-sell. Summary: 
- Commitment: 12 months, minimum committed spend ~ $420k (~10M tokens/month expected after ramp)
- Ask: 28% off standard hosted API usage rate for first 12 months + co-marketing credits
- Rationale: Strategic marketplace placement, reference customer for payer analytics, 3x expansion potential into EU/APAC in 2027; competitor (LargeCloudAI) has offered a similar introductory rate for marketplace onboarding

I've attached the deal econ and our PoC deck (brightwave_mopa_deck.pdf, deal_econ_v2.xlsx). Key downside is that this exceeds our >20% discount authority — seeking exec signoff.

Requested decision style: APPROVE (signature required) / COUNTER / DECLINE. Please respond with a short answer by EOD Monday 11/16 so I can lock commercial terms with procurement.

Why I think this is strategic: Brightwave's product maps directly to our targeted payer use case and they have three pilot customers that would drive predictable token volumes. They also agreed to an onboarding co-fund and marketplace listing (short-term revenue lift + marketing).

If helpful I can propose mitigations: 6-month stepped discount, up-front partial prepay, or stricter usage floors tied to the discount.

Thanks —
Elliot

Elliot —

Thanks for the write-up and the attachments. A few clarifying requests before I can recommend signoff: 
1) Break-even / unit economics: show the month-by-month NPV impact at the committed volumes (we need to see when discount breakeven occurs and gross margin tail).
2) Competitive context: who specifically is offering comparable terms and what’s the activation commitment from Brightwave in lieu of price (e.g., exclusive marketplace placement, joint PR, reference commitments)?
3) Risk mitigations: propose one of the following — (a) 6-month trial at 28% then step-down to 18% unless volumes meet floor, (b) prepay covering 4 months of committed usage, or (c) performance-based earnback tied to usage and adoption metrics.
4) Contractual asks: confirm data residency + SOC2 attestation are satisfied (procurement will need artifacts).

Also include the HubSpot deal link and any signed statements from Brightwave procurement if available. If we get the prepay or stepped plan we could likely approve. I'll escalate to Markus for exec sanctioning once the docs are in.

-Mina

Mina / Markus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers below and attaching the signed MoA draft and an updated econ tab (deal_econ_v2.xlsx -> tab: econ_readout):

1) Breakeven: At committed 10M tokens/month our blended gross margin with 28% discount reaches positive contribution in month 7 (assumes our marginal token cost of $0.0025 and support incremental FTE allocated at month 5). NPV over 12 months still positive when accounting for co-marketing credits because marketplace uplift projection is ~18% incremental ARR in 12 months. See econ_readout sheet.

2) Competitive context: LargeCloudAI offered an introductory 25% credit for marketplace onboarding but requires exclusive marketplace placement for 9 months; Brightwave prefers non-exclusive and has pushed for a partner listing across multiple marketplaces. Their exec sponsor (Sara Nguyen) confirmed they prefer Redwood for smaller onboarding friction and our inference latency profile.

3) Proposed mitigations (choose one as part of approval):
   - Option A (preferred by BD): 28% for first 6 months, then 18% for months 7-12; full list thereafter unless renewal signed.
   - Option B: 28% for 12 months but with 25% prepay on T+30 (covers ~3 months of committed usage).
   - Option C: 28% for 12 months with quarterly earnback credits if usage thresholds are met (detailed thresholds in econ sheet).

4) Compliance: Brightwave provided SOC2 Type II report and signed data processing addendum; attached signed_moa_draft.pdf includes the residency clause (US, EU regions selectable). Procurement has placed this token in HubSpot for signature.
